items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: I was a little bit of boy when Dave was playing

ctx.x: We were talking about Dave Bailey
Yeah Yeah Yeah Dave Bailey I was a little bit of boy when Dave was playing He don't look it though do he? No Yeah he gone down now plenty though He can't take all that walking right now
Well now you said something about the Liberty Bell?

items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: No, I mean Eddie Morris when he was playing with us.

ctx.x: You got a picture of the Liberty Bell?
No, I mean Eddie Morris when he was playing with us.
Oh yeah, that picture of the Gibson or the Jackson, I don't remember which it was. No, I never showed you the Liberty Bell.
